description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - Revisions made to the Minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1877/27 of 28/08/2014
categorisation: This gazette notification contains revisions to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, detailing promotion procedures, qualifications, and interim provisions for public service officers. It involves public service recruitment schemes, promotion criteria, and instructions from the Public Service Commission, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) for public sector administration and service conditions.
